settings.heading: Everyday things, chosen to last
settings.text: We keep the range to six pieces. Each one solves a small daily problem, and keeps doing it after a year of use.
settings.image_note: Hero lifestyle image — pour-over set on a kitchen counter, natural daylight

settings.heading: Six things we stand behind
settings.lead: Small batches, named materials, and a repair or refund if one of them lets you down.

settings.body: The pour-over set replaced two things on my counter, which was the point. Third month of daily use and the glaze still looks new. Packed properly, arrived in two days.
I ordered the apron expecting something stiff. It softened after one wash and the ties are long enough to knot in front. The pocket could be a little deeper.
Wrote on a Sunday about a delayed parcel and had a real answer on Monday morning. The lamp itself is heavier and better made than the photos suggest.

settings.heading: Why we keep the range small
settings.text: Most online shops sell thousands of things. We sell six. That is not modesty; it is the whole idea. Every piece here had to earn its place. It has to solve something small you deal with every day, and still be worth having a year from now. Most things we look at do not make the cut. We are a small business, not a warehouse. If something we sell does not hold up, we want to hear about it, and we will make it right.
settings.image_note: Workshop image — hands folding linen, warm daylight

settings.heading: One letter a month
settings.text: New pieces, restocks, and what we learned about the makers. No more than twelve emails a year, and you can leave in one click.
